text:
anya: quick sketch idea: what if the roles list used a 'role-band' pattern — each role is a horizontal band with the name pinned left, primary actions grouped to the right, and a subtle inheritance pill under the name. goal: faster glancing and fewer columns for big orgs

jules: curious about discoverability. how would you surface the permission matrix? inline tooltip? expand on click?

anya: expand-on-click for full permission list. inline we show a two-line summary (e.g., \"Can manage servers, view logs\") and member count. clicking the band expands an accordion with full toggles.

marco: dev note: virtualized list + expandable rows can get tricky with height recalculation. we should prototype with our existing InfiniteList component first. also sticky name column + scroll sync is doable but watch DOM thrash.

ui-bot: added a quick mock: https://figma.redwood/role-band/mock1 (band + compact/comfortable density). shows an audit peek icon and invite CTA visible on hover or focus.

anya: accessibility items: keyboard should have a single-entry focus per band (the band itself), pressing Enter expands; Tab inside opens first actionable element (invite). screen-reader: the band should have an aria-label summarizing role name, seats, top perms to avoid verbose lists. example: role=\"listitem\" aria-label=\"Support Role 1 members 1 can escalate incidents, view logs\"\\

tess: agree. also ensure the expand/collapse state is exposed with aria-expanded and the expanded container has role=\"region\" and aria-labelledby to the band. focus management: when expanding via keyboard focus must move into the region's first interactive control.

jules: SSO question: product currently enforces SSO at org-level only. we shouldn't show a working per-role toggle. options: a) hide entirely b) show a disabled toggle with explanatory link c) show a read-only badge that links to org SSO. thoughts?

anya: leaning to (b): show a disabled toggle with microcopy and a direct link 'Manage SSO' that opens org settings. makes intent visible without promising feature parity.

marco: implementation note: disabled controls in a band risk being focusable. ensure tabindex=-1 and include the explanation in a tooltip triggered on hover/focus of the disabled control's container. tooltips must be accessible (aria-describedby on the container).

ui-bot: suggested tooltip copy (long): \"Per-role SSO enforcement is not available yet. To require SSO for everyone, enable it in Organization settings.\" short: \"SSO set at Organization level.\"

tess: prefer the longer copy but trim to keep screen-reader verbosity reasonable. also color & contrast: the inheritance pill and seat count must meet AA for text. please provide contrast numbers for each density variant.

jules: audit flow: instead of taking users to a separate page, let's open a right-side slide-over with the audit timeline and a condensed filter bar. keep the slide-over modal-less but with an ARIA role=dialog and focus trap so keyboard users don't lose context. close should return focus to the original band.

marco: agree on slide-over. note: for mobile we should be full-screen. also pagination in audit timeline should be virtualized to avoid heavy payloads.

anya: action items: ui-bot/jules: update mocks with role-band densities + contrast values and include tooltip copy variations. marco: prototype infinite list + accordion performance and confirm tabindex behavior for disabled SSO control. tess: write SR patterns (aria-label templates, aria-expanded usage, focus-return behavior). we'll review Wednesday 3pm in design crit.

jules: done, added to calendar. thanks everyone :smile:
